item.text: The failures cluster into two underlying issues: reference definitions are parsed with a single-line regex, and bracket matching commits to an outer link before checking whether an inner link already formed. I’m replacing the definition collector with a multiline grammar and tightening inline destination/reference tokenization so malformed candidates fall back to reference syntax correctly.
